definition: Restrictions on how many requests or how much data a user or application can send to a system within a given time period.
details: Rate limiting is used by AI API providers to manage infrastructure load, ensure fair access across customers, and mitigate abuse such as automated scraping or denial-of-service attempts.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. And that is Rate Limiting — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
